# Distribute Candies.

@example Half the jar is three candies, and the jar has three kinds, 4, -2 and 0: a 4, a -2 and the 0 cover all of them.
[4,-2,4,4,0,-2]
=> 3

@example All eight candies are of different kinds, but you take only four of them.
[5,8,1,9,3,7,2,6]
=> 4

@example You take three candies, but the jar has only two kinds, 11 and -30.
[11,11,11,11,11,-30]
=> 2

# The smallest jar: you take one candy, whether the two are of one kind or of two.
[0,0]
=> 1

[-1,100000]
=> 1

# A single kind.
[-100000,-100000,-100000,-100000,-100000,-100000]
=> 1

[9,9,9,-9,-9,0]
=> 3

=> 2

[-12,-70,-3,-88,-41,-5,-19,-60]
=> 4

=> 5
